static_traits.name: Chen Kaiwen
static_traits.family_status: Long-term tense relationships with family, frequent conflicts; sometimes family refuses to communicate with them
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support system, hard to discuss problems with friends or family
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; has not yet received psychological counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe emotions and thoughts; slightly nervous at first consultation; high cooperativeness, positive attitude; tending to treat negative thoughts as reality, presenting a sense of despair

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel disappointed with daily life, and find it hard to get along with family.
basic_info.core_demands: I hope to view things from a more positive perspective, stop despairing about family and life, and find ways to make daily life more satisfying.
growth_experiences: Years of accumulated tense relationships and frequent conflicts with family have led to significant emotional distress and disappointment with life; has not yet actively tried to solve these problems, and has weak social support (difficulty discussing problems with friends or family); no major physical illness history.

core_beliefs: I am destined to be lonely, unable to receive support and love
Others (especially family) will never understand me
Things will not get better; life is utterly hopeless

special_situations.event: After arguing or conflicting with family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am unable to reconcile with family right now, the relationship can never be repaired; if conflicts continue, it means I am not loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding dealing with problems, reducing communication, not actively seeking support; indulging in the negative fantasy of 'being an animal to escape' to flee pain
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We will never be able to repair the relationship; I will grow old alone

special_situations.event: When encountering challenges or setbacks in daily life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If things are not going well now, it means they will not improve later; any setback means overall failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Loses motivation, gives up action, and stays in negative thinking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nothing will get better; everything is meaningless

special_situations.event: During daily interactions with family (conversations, getting along)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one interaction has conflict, it means all our interactions will be conflict; either completely harmonious, or destined to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces proactive communication to avoid conflicts happening again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every interaction we have is a conflict; there is no possibility of improvement at all

special_situations.event: Moments of feeling the family refuses to communicate with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they refuse to talk to me now, it means they will never accept me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not seeking other social support or opportunities for constructive communication
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will die lonely, without any support or love

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to be understood and accepted by family, building stable and close relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected and abandoned, ultimately growing old alone
defense_goal: Avoiding further hurt and conflict by maintaining emotional distance and not actively discussing problems

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about family conflicts or when real-life stress rises (e.g., after arguments)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The subconscious experiences real situations as 'no matter what I do, it will not improve', fleeing instead into fantasy (transference: confirming inner despair with the image of an unchangeable outside world)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Acknowledging their pain and longing in a gentle, empathetic tone, while softly bringing the topic back from fantasy to the present concrete situation; using open-ended questioning to help them identify small controllable actions and sources of support, avoiding judgment and excessive pushing.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When describing family and relationship prospects (e.g., believing 'never able to repair')
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing family and relationships as 'all bad / unchangeable', unable to accommodate shades of gray or exceptions (transference: simplifying complex relationships into absolute rejection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining a steady, non-confrontational tone; using concretization and de-extremizing reflections; inviting recall of any exceptional moments or small positive interactions to help see shades of gray, avoiding direct refutation of their experience.

manifestations: Believing family will never reconcile with oneself
Repeatedly having the thought 'I will grow old alone, without support or love'
outcomes: Intense feelings of despair and helplessness
Social withdrawal and not actively seeking help

manifestations: Feeling 'everything is meaningless' when encountering challenges in daily life
Negative emotions appear daily, experienced as 'a black cloud hanging over'
outcomes: Losing the will and interest to act
Stuck in negative thinking and giving up trying

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Not actively seeking support or discussing problems (even when emotional distress is evident)
Reducing communication and expression after conflict to avoid further contact

positive_force: Actively seeking counseling, positive and cooperative attitude
Able to express clearly and identify the impact of one's own negative thinking
Willing to try change and practice new thinking, open to the plan
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking
Despair about family relationships and the belief that things will 'never get better'
Weak social support system; avoiding discussion and not actively seeking help
Daily functioning affected (decreased drive, feeling life is utterly meaningless)

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic automatic thoughts and intense despair after family conflicts or life challenges, accompanied by decreased drive and avoidance of action
antecedent: Encountering difficulties or setbacks in daily life
target_behavior.core_reason: Based on the core belief 'I am destined to be lonely, unable to receive support and love' and the cognitive distortion that things will 'never improve' (catastrophizing, overgeneralization, black-and-white thinking, predicting the future)
target_behavior.function: Escaping painful emotions and relationship risks, gaining brief psychological retreat and a sense of control (including fantasy escape)
target_behavior.consequence: Losing motivation to act; reduced communication and help-seeking; declining daily functioning; further deterioration of family relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding handling interpersonal conflicts and seeking support (not actively discussing problems with family or friends)
antecedent: After an argument or when thinking of communicating with others
Moments of feeling 'meaningless / will not get better'
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being rejected and hopeless outcomes; maintaining the conditional assumption that 'discussion is useless too'
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential negative feedback and conflict, maintaining short-term emotional stability
target_behavior.consequence: Social support further weakened; problems persist and worsen; increased sense of loneliness
